messages:
kevin: Quick decision needed: do we ship "burst escrow" (credits reserved but only redeemable during agreed windows) or a simpler daily allowance for GA?
maya: Escrow gives legal clarity and avoids surprise billing, but is more infra work. Daily allowance is easiest to explain to customers.
dave: From infra: escrow requires a lightweight lease service and admin ops endpoints. Ballpark 2 sprint effort. Daily allowance is config-only.
priya: Customers in pilots asked for predictable windows more than rollover. Escrow = contractable burst windows, sounds attractive for enterprise.
kevin: If we pick escrow, propose default: 30s windows, one guaranteed window/day, unredeemed escrow returns to pool after 24h. Thoughts?
maya: Agree with defaults but make them configurable per-tenant. Also require audit trail and email notice 24h before credit expiry.
dave: Ops checklist: implement /admin/escrow/{tenant}/redeem, /admin/escrow/{tenant}/revoke; emit escrow_redeem_audit. Also metric: escrow_redeem_failures_total.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag created: burst-escrow (off).
kevin: Decision call: escrow for GA but behind opt-in flag and only for enterprise contracts. Action items: (1) Dave RFC for lease service, (2) Maya draft SLA appendix & notice language, (3) Priya notify pilot customers. Review Tue 9am.
priya: Noted. I'll ping AcmePilot and Napa to confirm they want escrow opt-in.
